values.value: Finds: Bundles where some options have SBQQ__SubscriptionType__c = Evergreen and others = Renewable. Why it matters: Renewal cycles fracture — the renewal quote generates two separate flows for one logical bundle. Customers see split renewal dates, and the CSM has to manually reconcile. Often becomes a revenue-leakage source as one half slips past its renewal window. Suppress a finding: when the mixed model is intentional (e.g. perpetual core + renewable add-on services). Disable the detector: only if your business model deliberately mixes subscription types within bundles. Most orgs should leave this on.
